title: Commercial-Use Rider to the Battery Replacement Warranties
content:
Holding a Crestline Fleet Account changes Battery Replacement Warranties terms on the fleet's vehicles.

## Terms of the rider

1. **When the rider applies.** The rider applies to a free replacement or a prorated adjustment when the vehicle is in commercial use on the date of the claim.
2. **Commercial use.** A vehicle is in commercial use on the claim date when the vehicle record declares its usage as commercial, or when the latest entry for the vehicle on a Crestline Fleet Account roster is the vehicle's enrolment; otherwise it is not in commercial use.
3. **Periods.** Under the rider the free period is the line's commercial-use free months and the prorated period is the line's commercial-use prorated-through months, in place of the line's personal-use figures, and the credit percentage is computed on the commercial prorated period.
4. **Commercial Heavy-Duty line.** The Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery has the same figures for both uses.
5. **Fleet battery discount.** When a battery is charged to a Crestline Fleet Account, the fleet battery discount applies where the line marks the fleet account's battery discount as applicable.

## Commercial use, every combination

| Usage declared on the vehicle record | Latest entry for the vehicle on a fleet roster | In commercial use on the claim date |
|---|---|---|
| commercial | enrolment | Yes |
| commercial | removal from the roster | Yes |
| commercial | no roster entry | Yes |
| personal | enrolment | Yes |
| personal | removal from the roster | No |
| personal | no roster entry | No |

## Credit percentage on the commercial period (hypothetical figures, not any line's)

Suppose a commercial prorated period of 20 months and 15 whole months in service at the adjustment. The months remaining are 5; 5 divided by 20, multiplied by 100, is 25, so the credit percentage is 25%. The personal-use prorated period of the line plays no part in that figure.

## Points of the rider

- The test is made on the claim date: what the vehicle record and the fleet roster show on that date decides it.
